title: Sofía Full-Stack Ultra Premium Completion
mission: Finish Sofía as an ultra premium supervised AI operations console with real backend data, clean frontend, safe WhatsApp QR receive-only flow, separated sandbox, strong security gates, and production blocked until explicit owner approval.
globalGuardrails: Do not enable real WhatsApp sending.
Do not enable Auto Safe production.
Do not mark PAID from WhatsApp.
Do not confirm payments from Sofía.
Do not move real orders from Sofía.
Do not modify POS, Caja, Stock, Checkout, Domicilios, prices, or catalog unless explicitly required by the story and still safe.
Do not change the Maxy Family commercial rule.
Do not expose .env, tokens, API keys, QR raw, data:image QR, full phone numbers, session auth, creds.json, or secrets.
Do not delete historical reports without traceability.

whatsapp.linkingIssue: Official company WhatsApp Business previously showed: No se pudo vincular el dispositivo

maxyFamily.allowedComposition: 6 burgers + 1 porción personal de papitas + 1 Pepsi 1.5 L
maxyFamily.allowedUpsell: Si quieres que todos acompañen con papitas, puedes agregar porciones adicionales.

globalGates.name: secret_scan
globalGates.expected: no real secrets, no QR raw, no data:image, no session auth exposure

stories.title: Sofía Full-Stack Master Diagnosis
stories.goal: Create a complete technical, visual, data, and security diagnosis for all Sofía routes before major changes.
acceptance: Diagnoses backend endpoints, frontend routes, data contracts, visual hierarchy, copy, sandbox separation, QR state, security, and missing pieces.
Does not modify code unless needed to inspect safely.
Documents exact plan for later stories.
Does not activate real sending, auto reply, or production.

stories.title: Sofía Data Contracts and API Consistency
stories.goal: Normalize backend contracts across dashboard, conversations, QR, AI, sandbox, governance, and readiness.
acceptance: All Sofía endpoints return sanitized data contracts with scope, security, real/internal/sandbox/historical separation where applicable.
No PII, no full phone, no QR raw, no secrets, no session auth.
Frontend types or adapters clearly match backend shape.
Missing data is represented as pending/no data, not invented.

stories.title: Sofía Ultra Premium Design System
stories.goal: Create or refine reusable Sofía UI components for ultra premium enterprise experience.
acceptance: Reusable components exist for page shell, hero, badges, metric cards, section cards, scope tabs, technical details, empty states, risk banners, conversation cards, QR cards, sandbox case cards.
No broken words.
Purple identity is elegant, not heavy.
Responsive desktop and mobile are clean.
Dangerous actions are visually blocked.

stories.title: Dashboard /sofia Final Premium Pass
stories.goal: Polish /sofia using real backend summary and ultra premium components.
acceptance: /sofia consumes GET /admin/sofia/dashboard/summary.
Shows operation real/internal/pending clearly.
No mock/sandbox/historical as real.
Production blocked, send blocked, auto reply OFF, DeepSeek dry-run.
Understood in 10 seconds.

stories.title: Conversations /sofia/conversations Final Premium Pass
stories.goal: Polish conversations inbox with backend inbox endpoint, clean states, tabs, cards, and technical details collapsed.
acceptance: Consumes GET /admin/sofia/conversations/inbox.
Real operation remains empty if allowlist pending.
Sandbox and historical are separated.
Reason codes are mapped to operational copy.
Original codes only in collapsed technical details.
No PII or full phone.

stories.title: WhatsApp QR Gateway Truthful Premium Experience
stories.goal: Make /sofia/whatsapp-qr truthful, premium, and diagnostic-ready for official WhatsApp Business linking issue.
acceptance: Shows real QR status from backend.
Does not show success unless connected=true.
Does not show QR ready unless qrAvailable=true.
Shows receive-only, real send blocked, auto reply OFF, production blocked.
Includes safe diagnostic for linking failure without exposing QR raw or session auth.
Does not activate real send.

stories.title: Sandbox /sofia/sandbox Premium Laboratory
stories.goal: Make sandbox a clearly separated premium laboratory for SafetyGuard, DeepSeek dry-run, and commercial rule tests.
acceptance: Clearly marked as laboratory.
Does not look like operation real.
No real send, no PAID, no production.
Test cases for unknown product, payment sensitive, human requested, Maxy Family correct/risky, low confidence, missing address, missing confirmation.
PASS/FAIL visible for test cases.
Details collapsed.

stories.title: Global Responsive and Visual QA
stories.goal: Run desktop/mobile visual QA across all Sofía routes and fix visual issues.
acceptance: Screenshots generated for desktop and mobile for all four routes.
No broken words.
No cramped cards.
No contrast problems.
No technical noise as main content.
Routes look ultra premium.

stories.title: Global Security and No Real Activation Audit
stories.goal: Audit all Sofía code and deployment reports for unsafe activation, secrets, QR raw, PII, PAID from WhatsApp, and protected module mutations.
acceptance: No real sending activation.
No auto reply activation.
No production activation.
No secrets or QR raw exposed.
No full phone numbers visible.
No PAID from WhatsApp.
POS/Caja/Stock/Checkout/Domicilios untouched.
Final report created.

stories.title: Sofía Final Readiness Report
stories.goal: Create final readiness report summarizing what is complete, what remains blocked, and exact next gates before production.
acceptance: Report includes backend, frontend, API, UI/UX, QR, AI, SafetyGuard, sandbox, security, build/typecheck, screenshots.
Clearly states production blocked.
Clearly states remaining gates: allowlist final, inbound real accepted, internal real send, kill-switch, rate limit, rollback, owner approval.
Decision is GO, GO CONDICIONADO, or NO-GO.
